mapper.insert: INSERT INTO invitation (issuer_account_id, token_digest, expires_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{issuerAccountId}, #{tokenDigest}, #{expiresAt}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(), UTC_TIMESTAMP())
mapper.select: SELECT id, issuer_account_id, token_digest, expires_at, used_at, used_by, created_at, updated_at FROM invitation ORDER BY created_at DESC
